Plastic Surgery Marketing Agency in Houston: Procedure SEO, Ads and Consultation Tracking

Houston plastic surgery practices often run SEO with one vendor, Google Ads with another and social media in-house, and nobody owns the full picture of which efforts produce booked consultations. We are a Houston-based team that can run procedure SEO, Google Ads and consultation tracking together, or audit the current setup so your existing vendors can work from one plan.

Houston plastic surgery challenges

A crowded market where split vendors hide what works

Houston is a competitive aesthetic market with many board-certified surgeons, med spas offering overlapping treatments, and agencies that specialize in aesthetics. Practices are pitched constantly. The common gap we see is not effort but coordination: SEO, ads and the website pursuing different procedures and reporting different numbers.

Vendors measure different things

The SEO report counts rankings, the ads report counts clicks, and the front desk counts consultations. None match.

Procedure pages miss key questions

Pages describe the procedure but not candidacy, recovery time, cost factors or which surgeon performs it.

Reviews and med spa overlap

Surgical and non-surgical services share one listing and one review stream, which blurs the practice's surgical reputation.

Typical Houston cosmetic inquiry (example of your audience)

  1. ResearchFor example 'breast augmentation Houston cost'
  2. Compare surgeonsCredentials, reviews, galleries
  3. Procedure pageCandidacy, recovery, surgeon
  4. InquiryForm, call or chat
  5. CoordinatorYour team qualifies and books

Search phrases are illustrative examples, not volume data.

Services

Plastic surgery marketing services for Houston practices

Chosen after review. We commit to the work and reporting; rankings and surgery numbers are not guaranteed.

Procedure SEO in Houston

Surgeon-approved procedure pages for your priority procedures, with local relevance where it is genuine.

Google Ads for plastic surgeons in Houston

Procedure-level campaigns, Houston-area targeting, negative keywords and dedicated landing pages.

Consultation tracking

Procedure and source tags on every inquiry, plus a coordinator field for qualified or booked.

Surgeon profiles

Credentials, training and focus procedures next to the pages patients read.

Maps and reviews

Google profile optimization and a review workflow; surgical and med spa services presented clearly.

Plastic surgery website design and fixes

Speed, mobile forms and page structure; full redesigns scoped only when justified.

See the plastic surgery marketing overview and our med spa SEO page if you also run a med spa.

Process and evidence

How we work with Houston plastic surgery practices

Local means we can meet at your practice when useful. Day to day, work runs on a shared task list and monthly calls with your practice manager and coordinator.

  1. Assess

    Procedure and surgeon pages, ads account, listings, inquiry forms and how inquiries reach coordinators.

  2. Prioritize

    Pick 3 to 5 priority procedures and the biggest leaks, often tracking and ad landing pages.

  3. Fix foundations

    Tracking, form fixes, procedure tagging and Google profile corrections.

  4. Improve content and campaigns

    Procedure pages and surgeon profiles, then procedure-level Google Ads.

  5. Measure and refine

    Monthly review with coordinator notes; budget shifts toward booked consultations.

Illustrative audit scope

What a Houston procedure-page and local-visibility audit covers

Format example, not a client result.

  • Each priority procedure page: candidacy, recovery, cost factors, surgeon link, form.
  • Google profile categories, services and reviews.
  • Ads: landing pages, negative keywords, location targeting.
  • Inquiry tracking and response path.

Who does what: we build, run and report. Your practice handles consultations, pricing, consent and clinical review.

Coverage and engagement

Houston plastic surgery coverage and availability

We are based in Houston. Plastic surgery is checked by ZIP code against reserved territories before any proposal.

Open, subject to ZIP check

Houston practices

Local service with in-person meetings when helpful. Send your office ZIP codes to confirm.

Scope

Full or partial

Run SEO, ads and tracking together, or audit your current vendors and coordinate them.

Ownership

Your accounts

Ad account, website and listings stay in the practice’s name.

Local search notes (reviewed 6 November 2026)

Agency searches such as ‘plastic surgery marketing agency Houston’ returned Houston-based agencies that work exclusively with aesthetic practices, national plastic surgery specialists with Houston landing pages, and general Houston agencies citing plastic surgery case studies. Buyers have many options, so the useful differentiators are reporting you can verify and account ownership. Qualitative observations only.

Pricing

Scope-based proposal after review; fees, ad spend and one-time work separated; 7 days’ notice. See the cost guide, medical SEO in Houston and the Texas hub.

Questions and consultation

Houston plastic surgery marketing questions

For surgeons, practice managers and coordinators.

What should a Houston procedure-page and local-visibility audit cover?

Every priority procedure page (candidacy, recovery, cost factors, surgeon link and form), surgeon profiles, Google Business Profile categories and services, review patterns, how ads are targeted and where they land, and whether inquiries are tagged by procedure and source. It ends with a ranked fix list.

Can one team coordinate SEO, ads and consultation tracking?

Yes, and it is often the most useful change. One plan sets the priority procedures, ads point to pages built for them, and one tracking setup feeds a single monthly report. If you prefer to keep current vendors, we can write the shared plan and tracking spec for them.

What does plastic surgery marketing in Houston cost?

Scope-based after review, with management fee, ad spend paid to Google and one-time website work separated.

How do you handle before-and-after photos?

We structure galleries and captions around your documented patient consent. We do not source, alter or publish clinical images without that consent.

How do you measure consultation quality?

Inquiries are tagged by procedure and source; your coordinators mark qualified or booked. We report the pattern monthly.

Is Houston plastic surgery marketing available in our ZIP code?

Send office ZIP codes and we confirm. Houston is not on our reserved list for plastic surgery, but each request is checked.
